missionVision.storySubtitle: From International Expertise To Regional Infrastructure
storyParagraphs: DYNATECH was established in 2017 with a vision centered around one clear objective: bringing advanced industrial technologies closer to the Egyptian and regional market.

As the automotive and manufacturing sectors globally shifted toward electrification, automation, and lightweight technologies, DYNATECH positioned itself as a bridge connecting international expertise with local industrial opportunities.

Over time, the company expanded beyond partnerships into infrastructure development through the creation of the DYNATECH Automotive Hub - a fully integrated automotive and technical ecosystem currently under development in New Cairo.
missionVision.visionText: To become a driving force supporting the advancement of mobility, manufacturing, and industrial infrastructure across Egypt and the MENA region through technology transfer, localization, and strategic partnerships.
missionVision.missionText: Seize high-potential opportunities in the automotive hub and turn them into successful industrial projects with technology partners who share the ambitious vision.

founder.name: Eng. Ahmed Sorour
founder.title: CEO & Founder
founder.intro: With more than 35 years of leadership experience across the automotive and industrial sectors in the MENA region, Eng. Ahmed Sorour brings a long-standing track record in luxury automotive operations, industrial development, and strategic business expansion.

experience.achievement: Recognized with Toyota's Best of the Best Award in Nagoya, Japan.
Led luxury automotive operations for BMW, Jaguar Land Rover, Rolls-Royce, and MINI, contributing to the company becoming Qatar's leading luxury automotive group.
Co-founded a 35,000 sqm automotive facility in partnership with Volkswagen Group and Qatar Investment Authority.
Founded DYNATECH with a vision focused on industrial modernization, advanced mobility infrastructure, and technology localization.

timeline.desc: DYNATECH Corp. was established alongside integration into the CFK Valley network in Germany.

DYNATECH for Industrial Development (DID) was established, and land was acquired from NUCA in New Cairo.
Composites United officially appoints DYNATECH as its exclusive representative in Egypt.
Strategic partnership agreement announced during Hannover Messe.
Exclusive agency agreement signed with FFT Produktionssysteme GmbH in Fulda, Germany.

Automotive Hub design phase completed, and CFC office officially handed over.
Construction completion and fit-out phase of the Automotive Hub.
Soft opening and operational launch of the DYNATECH Automotive Hub.
